about: The message roles each real client sends on the OpenAI route, never their content: captured on the reference box on 2026-10-24 through a relay in front of the proxy (opencode 1.19.4, Hermes Agent, pi, the OpenAI SDK, fetch under Node and Bun, LiteLLM). tests/lane-templates-check.py renders each shape, with tools and without, through every text lane's chat template as its installer serves it. assistant_tool_call is an assistant turn that calls a tool, tool the tool's answer. A shape marked derived was not captured as such: the note says what it stands for.
